text: Your BRO has so much sweet gear it's hard to keep up with it all sometimes. Here's his computer setup. He's usually got a lot of stuff cooking on here at any given moment.
Since he's not around you might as well sneak a peep.
alt: There's random shit all over the place. A lot of puppets. There's a Kermit the Frog poster on the wall.
command: Dave: Look at your brother's computer.
